title: Objective v1
description: config/intent/OBJ-<name>.json (D-347): an objective measured against a baseline and a target (INCOSE NRM 4.3.2 mission, goals and objectives with their measures; BABOK 6.2 future state; ISO 21502 7.3 benefits): the problems it addresses, its measure (the kinds of a validation, read by the same function), its baseline, its target and when, and the decisions that chose the solution. Its state is derived by scripts/model from the measure, the benefit reading (met, not-met, measuring while the window is short, defined while no source is wired), never written; the gap is the target less the measure, never stored. Needs derive from it.

kind.description: merges-per-day: merges on main's first-parent line per complete UTC day, averaged over the window's days; trailer-rate: the share of merges whose commits carry `trailer`, over the window's merges; escape-rate: the share of the window's merged changes that an escape (INC-escape-<n>, from a later merge's `Fixes-PR:` trailer) was introduced by; model-share: a share scripts/model computes (`name`); incident-count: the incident records (scripts/incident) of kind `incident` opened over the window's days; code-scan: the sleep calls inside a loop in the code under `paths` less `exclude` (globs), the candidates for polling; all-met: how many of the validations `of` are not met, measuring while any is short of data or has no source; run-durations: the `percentile` of the durations in a recorded snapshot of `workflow` (config/validation/runs/: a GitHub workflow's runs by scripts/runs, or `deploy`, the AWS deploy's succeeded builds by scripts/deploy status), measuring while it holds fewer than `min_runs` runs or is older than `max_age_days`; aws-spend: the AWS account's unblended spend for the month to date in US$, from the snapshot of the deploy build's daily Cost Explorer reading (config/validation/spend/aws.json, scripts/spend), measuring while it is of another month or older than `max_age_days` (a reading of this month over the threshold is final); supplier-spend: a supplier's spend in US$ from a reading checked by hand against its invoice (config/validation/spend/<supplier>.json, scripts/lib/spend.py read_supplier), measuring once older than `max_age_days` (D-342); unwired: no source is wired yet (`source` says which).

threshold_key.description: A registry key whose value is the threshold (D-342), so the number lives in one key. A validation carries threshold or threshold_key, exactly one (scripts/model read_validations refuses both or neither: a oneOf here would not be an additive change of v1).

source.description: The command or record that measured it.

decided_by.description: The decisions that chose the solution.
